title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: detention rate class of a reefer unit carrying non-reefer cargo
content:
## Scope

For the final detention line of a per-container record under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule decides which rate class the container's detention days are billed at. It reads the cargo type of the booking the container moves under.

## Rule

The rate class of the container is taken from the product's equipment class map, except that a container whose mapped class is reefer is billed at reefer-class rates only when the booking it moves under has the cargo type reefer. A reefer unit moving under a booking of any other cargo type is a non-operating reefer, and every one of its days is billed at dry-class rates.

## Decision table

| Class given by the equipment class map | Cargo type of the booking the container moves under | Rate class billed |
|---|---|---|
| reefer | reefer | reefer |
| reefer | any other cargo type | dry (non-operating reefer) |
| special | any | special |
| dry | any | dry |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A 40-foot reefer unit is shipped under a booking of general dry cargo. Which detention rates apply?**
A: Dry-class rates for every detention day, because the booking's cargo type is not reefer.

**Q: Does the rule change the class of a special-class container?**
A: No. Only a container whose mapped class is reefer is affected; other containers keep the class the map gives them.
